title: What to do as a family in September | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for September for the whole family: the woods and mushrooms, the harvest and the jars, clearing cupboards and the park. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: September
heading: What to do as a family in September
lead: September is the real new year of a family with children: the holidays are over, the timetable is back, and the month goes by unnoticed unless you decide in advance what it will be filled with.
It is still warm enough for the woods and for clearing a park, and everything that can be cooked and put up has just ripened. It is the one month where both fit.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
